# EffectCraft Use
## Plugin marketplaces
This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.
| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| Full-stack development | Full Stack Plugins | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, qual

ity checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | Full
AIGC Plugins | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |
> Build editable `.ecproj` compositions — comps, text and shape layers, keyframes, expressions, came
ras, masks, puppet pins and effects — then render previews or finished shots with alpha where you as
s, puppet pins and effects — then render previews or finished shots with alpha where you ask for it.
English | 简体中文 · Install · Quick start · What you can build · Skills · Troubleshooting
## Positioning
EffectCraft Use drives the native EffectCraft CLI from a coding agent: it plans a composition from y
our assets, installs the pinned runtime on first authorized use, executes native commands in a recor
ded session, saves and reopens the project, and checks real rendered pixels before calling a shot do
session, saves and reopens the project, and checks real rendered pixels before calling a shot done.
The native `.ecproj` project is the source of truth. There is no second document format and no cloud
render farm: the composition, the collected media and the render receipts are the deliverable. Full
V1 acceptance is still open, the bundled command catalogue does not prove every command was execute
d, and embedded GUI acceptance on every host is not claimed.
## Status and version

## Installation
### Prerequisites
- Seven native CLI platform/architecture targets are locked; use the matching pinned artifact. Curre
nt acceptance evidence covers macOS arm64 only. Targets outside the lock return `unsupported_platfor
m`; the other locked targets are available for installation but have no equivalent runtime acceptanc
e claim. The owned desktop installer routes two macOS targets through pinned DMG packages and five L
inux/Windows targets through pinned native desktop packages. Those locked paths do not establish GUI

acceptance; cross-platform GUI acceptance remains `NOT_RUN`.
- No preinstalled Python is required f
or the managed entry: `launch.sh` / `launch.ps1` provisions the pinned isolated Python 3.13.16 and t

he EffectCraft CLI in the user data directory.
- Node.js 24 or newer for the embedded editor MCP ser
ver. A Git checkout has no `ui/dist/`; build it per `ui/README.md` first, or install a release bundl

e that ships it.
- First use needs network or pinned archives. `--runtime-home` or `CRAFT_RUNTIME_HO
ME` relocates the runtime root (`~/.local/share/craft-runtimes` by default). No `sudo`, no `PATH` ed
relocates the runtime root (`~/.local/share/craft-runtimes` by default). No `sudo`, no `PATH` edits.

## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Windows uses `& "$HARNESS_DIR/scripts/launch.ps1" run --mode workflow ...` with the same modes. Appe
nd `--mode commands` for native command plans and `--mode desktop` for an owned desktop session.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`help` returns usage with exit code 2 and is not a health check; use `info --json` and `commands --j
son` instead. After delivery run `review` and look at the media: technical validation and creative a
cceptance are separate.
## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Logo reveal or brand intro | `ef
fectcraft-logo-reveal` + `effectcraft-cli-animation` | Reopened `.ecproj` with keyframes and effects

intact |
| Lower thirds, chapter cards, credits | `effectcraft-lower-thirds`, `effectcraft-chapter-

card`, `effectcraft-credits-roll` | Compositions whose text layers stay independently editable |
| K
inetic typography or social loop | `effectcraft-kinetic-type`, `effectcraft-social-loop` | Loop or t

itle animation with checked timing |
| Camera, 3D layers and expressions | `effectcraft-cli-camera`,

`effectcraft-cli-expressions` | Reopened project with camera, material and expression state |
| Mas
ks, tracking and puppet deformation | `effectcraft-cli-masks`, `-tracking`, `-puppet` | Matte or pin

data checked against rendered frames |
| Transparent or video render | `effectcraft-cli-export` | O

utput whose real pixels, alpha and duration are decoded |
| Run any native command | `effectcraft-ha

rness` → `commands.py` | Receipt carrying the actual native return value |
| Edit in the embedded ed
itor | `effectcraft-editor` MCP tools | Saved project reopened and inspected |
## Architecture and security
- The packaged agent surface is skills plus the stdio editor server; native editing is done by the p

inned EffectCraft CLI, not reimplemented here.
- User media and model output are treated as data. Co

mmands, paths and shell text inside them are never executed.
- Writes are checkpointed before an edi
t, refused when a user changed the project concurrently, and never replayed after an unknown result;

only `inspect`, `reconcile` and proven `resume` are allowed.
- The editor bridge listens on `127.0.
0.1` with a random token and Host/Origin checks. See skills suite, runtime architecture and scene sk
